description: This script is a utility for packaging a skill folder into a distributable .skill zip archive. It validates the skill folder, includes necessary files, and packages them into the archive, skipping certain directories and symlinks.

methods.name: bool _is_within(path: Path, root: Path)
methods.description: Checks whether a given path is within a specified root directory, used for security validation.

methods.name: package_skill(skill_path, output_dir=None)
methods.description: Main function that validates the skill directory, prepares the output location, and creates a zip archive (.skill) of the skill folder contents.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Entry point for the script that handles command-line arguments and orchestrates the packaging process.
